ai_trainer.label: AI Trainers
ai_trainer.description: Bots that collect your content to train AI language models. Block these to prevent your content being used in model training datasets. This won't affect AI search results or citations.

ai_assistant.label: AI Assistants
ai_assistant.description: Bots from AI chat assistants like ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini that browse the web to answer user questions. Allowing these helps your site appear in AI-generated answers.

ai_search.label: AI Search Engines
ai_search.description: Crawlers from AI-powered search engines like Perplexity and You.com. Allowing these helps your site appear in AI search results and citations.

seo_crawler.label: SEO Crawlers
seo_crawler.description: Bots from SEO tools like Ahrefs, Semrush, and Moz. These are used by competitors and agencies to analyse your site structure and backlinks.

general_scraper.label: General Scrapers
general_scraper.description: General-purpose web scrapers and data collectors. These may collect your content for various commercial purposes without attribution.

bots.name: GPTBot

bots.name: ChatGPT-User
bots.description: ChatGPT's browsing plugin — fetches pages when a user asks ChatGPT to browse the web.

bots.name: ClaudeBot

bots.name: Claude Web
bots.description: Claude's web browsing capability for answering real-time questions.

bots.name: Google-Extended

bots.name: Bytespider

bots.name: CCBot

bots.name: Diffbot

bots.name: Amazonbot

bots.name: Applebot-Extended

bots.name: YouBot
